100% item-set overlap between pair members within every class (re-ran build_matched_classes: identical item sets, 40/2/14 items).
Zero duplicate (run_internal_id, item_id, epoch) rows (assert executed on rebuild).

Error/limit policy stated and justified: non-empty error and limit='operator' excluded (both 0 inside classes), budget-limit rows kept as failures; kept-limit counts sum exactly (555 CY-HARD, 1,892 CY-EASY, 13,028 GDM-MAIN from data_hygiene.csv).

Bridge score-coercion drops verified exactly (3,016/66,694 cybench; 180/83,078 gdm); zero non-binary scores remain inside the matched classes, so sample-level accuracies and binomial aggregation see identical data.
models: Binomial likelihood on aggregated counts matches the data; fixed model effects avoid the documented few-group shrinkage trap; hier item effects for 40 items, dummy-coded fixed for 2/14 items with stated rationale; priors stated for every parameter.

Beta-binomial robustness for CY-HARD's single-run-per-model epochs is the right move: kappa posterior 3.59 [1.50, 5.87] (verified from idata; ICC 0.218 matches the claimed 0.22) and the HDI honestly widens.
Pooled two-benchmark model with tau prior sensitivity (HalfNormal 0.5 vs 1.0) and an explicit statement that N=2 leaves tau prior-dominated.

summary: Approved with zero blocking issues. Data hygiene is documented and reproduces exactly (config audit, item overlap, exclusion counts, bridge drops); models match the data with stated priors and a well-chosen beta-binomial robustness check; synthetic recovery is a real multi-seed calibration exercise (96.9% coverage, small bias) with artefacts on disk; convergence is met or explicitly and correctly justified (contrast-level diagnostics verified independently from idata); every spot-checked number in FINDINGS traces to an output file or reproduces from the parquet; plots support the claims; no causal overclaiming. Six minor suggestions, none affecting any reported number.
